data.body: RESUMED ON A NEW WORKSTATION 2026-09-12. Study restored to /Users/joeoakhart/plan-review-bakeoff from the Desktop backup: 846,504 files, 12G, source and copy file counts match, git repo intact at 65ab36d with a clean tree. ARM TOOLING WAS ENTIRELY ABSENT and has been reconstituted, pinned to the study's versions: compound-engineering 3.24.0 at commit 3ad9b51b (the default branch had already moved to 3.25.0, released the same day, so an unpinned clone would have silently changed the CE arm), superpowers at tag v6.3.0, both cloned into plugins/ (gitignored) with the four ~/.claude/skills/ symlinks recreated and verified to resolve to real SKILL.md files. mini-venv survived the move intact (mini-swe-agent 2.4.6, Python 3.14.7) because the directory returned to the same absolute path. Sole deviation, recorded in harness/FIDELITY_LOG.md and committed as a169e8c: skills now resolve through plan-review-bakeoff/plugins/ rather than a plugin-manager install dir; content is version-identical. Harness verified: status.py 20/220 runs complete, 20 artifacts; extract.py resolves all four arms on 2948-48e5-BLOCK (rebar 17, ce 18, sp 14, mini 5); CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS=40. STATE RECONCILED AGAINST DISK, and two log entries are stale: HANDOFF.md's 'State as of this handoff' table (CE 2 / sp 6 / mini 0 / artifacts 0) predates Wave 1 closing, and the Wave 3 entry of 09-09 17:46 says sourcing is in progress when wave3/SELECTION.md now records the final 20 chosen from 68 unique candidates, each with repo and pinned SHA, plus validation exclusions and instruction-text banners. TRUE OPEN THREADS: Wave 2 Q1 replicability not started; Wave 2 Q3 iterations-to-pass at pilot stage (one plan 2948-48e5-BLOCK, ce arm only, METHOD.md written); Wave 3 selection complete but no run manifest and no arms dispatched. No reviews were dispatched during this restore.
